class.name: FloatSpreener
class.brief_description: Interpolates an [Object]'s [float] property based on the damping ratio and halflife of a spring.
class.description: [FloatSpreener] is used to interpolate a [float] property of an object. See [method Spreen.spreen_float]. [b]Note:[/b] [method Spreen.spreen_float] is the only correct way to create [FloatSpreener]. Any [FloatSpreener] created manually will not function correctly.

method.name: update_goal
method.description: Updates the goal of the [FloatSpreener] in real time. When used in tandem with [method Spreen.set_finishable] can be used to dampen noisy inputs.
